impact.text: A portion of matured weekly rewards becomes permanently stuck in `RewardsDistributor` whenever funding/checkpointing happens before any ve holders exist for that week (including the first/funding week).

precondition_sources.text: The Minter funds RewardsDistributor with reward tokens.
No veHYBR locks exist for the week being checkpointed, so totalSupplyAtT(week_end) is zero for that week.

intent_sources.text: Weekly reward allocations must remain claimable by veHYBR holders; allocations for zero-supply weeks must not become permanently unclaimable.
If totalSupplyAtT(week_end) == 0, tokens_per_week[week] should be carried into the next week with nonzero supply rather than fixed to the zero-supply week.
